credits.title: Bad Apples
credits.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

credits.title: Wild Swimmers
credits.overview: Beneath the surface of an English river, something ancient is awake.  When wild swimmers begin vanishing without trace, trainee journalist Deji decides to investigate. But the further downstream she goes, the more the old stories resurface. And when the river turns red, it's time to start swimming.

credits.title: Another Day In Buenoseres
credits.overview: In an unusual bar on an unknown planet, filled with unlikely characters, power takes on new meaning. ‘Company man’ Gus is on the hunt for the last target on his contract, but in this world of dark deeds, shady characters and supernatural assassins, all but the best laid plans go awry.

credits.title: Talia
credits.overview: Talia loves nature. When she discovers the lady next door shares her curiosity for the wilderness, they strike up an unusual friendship.

credits.title: RED 2
credits.overview: Retired C.I.A. agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives for a global quest to track down a missing portable nuclear device.

credits.title: The Truth About Love
credits.overview: As part of a drunken bet with her sister Felicity, happily married Alice sends an anonymous Valentine's card to her husband Sam to see if he hides it. When he does, what was a prank leads to a series of events and revelations that may put her marriage at risk, and leaves her looking for answers.
